signals.context: General Freight Trucking, Long-Distance Truckload PPI is up 0.7% versus its recent baseline. This medium-conviction signal suggests strengthening truck freight pressure, likely tied to capacity tightness, fuel-cost pass-through, regional produce/retail replenishment, or port congestion. Confirm with route-level spot quotes, tender rejection data, port dwell times, and fuel surcharges before trading or procurement decisions.

Line-Haul Railroads: Intermodal Freight Rail Transportation PPI is down 0.2% versus its recent baseline. This medium-conviction signal suggests softening rail freight pressure, likely tied to intermodal demand shifts, network congestion, coal/grain seasonality, or ocean-to-rail rerouting. Confirm with route-level spot quotes, tender rejection data, port dwell times, and fuel surcharges before trading or procurement decisions.

Scheduled Air Freight/Air Transportation PPI Proxy is up 1.3% versus its recent baseline. This medium-conviction signal suggests strengthening air freight pressure, likely tied to urgent inventory replenishment, electronics/product-launch cycles, belly-cargo capacity changes, or ecommerce demand. Confirm with route-level spot quotes, tender rejection data, port dwell times, and fuel surcharges before trading or procurement decisions.
